rubric_criteria.label_0: Irrelevant: Domain disconnect, incompatible location, severe seniority clash, or zero technical overlap.
rubric_criteria.label_1: Partially Relevant: Adjacent technical role/domain, transferable core skills, acceptable stretch seniority, or career-changer fit.
rubric_criteria.label_2: Strongly Relevant: Direct target role match, high core skill synergy, compatible seniority, and satisfied location.
